INSERT INTO im_contact (room_id, uid, last_msg_id, active_time, is_del) VALUES
(#{roomId},#{uid},#{msgId},#{activeTime},0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_del = 0, hide = 0, last_msg_id = IF(#{msgId} > last_msg_id OR last_msg_id IS NULL, #{msgId}, last_msg_id), active_time = IF(#{activeTime} > active_time OR active_time IS NULL, #{activeTime}, active_time)

INSERT INTO im_contact (room_id, uid, last_msg_id, active_time, is_del) VALUES
(#{roomId},#{uid},#{msgId},#{activeTime},0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_del = IF(#{msgId} < last_msg_id, 0, is_del), hide = IF(#{msgId} < last_msg_id, 0, hide), last_msg_id = IF(#{msgId} < last_msg_id, VALUES(last_msg_id), last_msg_id), active_time = IF(#{msgId} < last_msg_id, VALUES(active_time), active_time)
INSERT INTO im_contact (room_id, uid, is_del) VALUES (#{roomId},#{uid},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_del = 0, hide = 0

INSERT INTO im_contact (room_id, uid, last_msg_id, is_del) VALUES
(#{roomId},#{uid},#{msgId},0)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_msg_id = IF(#{msgId} > last_msg_id OR last_msg_id IS NULL, #{msgId}, last_msg_id)
